chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: Betty Roche singing at rehearsals
summary: Singer Betty Roche came by rehearsals daily; Collins compares her to Carmen McRae.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: This was in 19 -- around 1940, around that time, yes. It was around 1940. And we did have a little girl who used to come down and sing with us during rehearsal, her name was Betty Roche. You ever hear of her?
Betty would sing with us everyday. She just loved it. That's right, she sang with Duke, didn't she.
Yeah, well this was before then.
I knew her then and I saw her last summer in New York.
You did? Gosh, I'd love to see her. She sang with Clark Terry's
(inaudible) band (inaudible) at a concert at the New School.
Still singing good? Well, she was a
good singer, good jazz singer. You know. She was then what Carmen is now. The same approach, you know, the same approach to singing. Marvelous.
